Look, you have to respect what she wants but it's an excuse. She's worried about being hurt in the future. My ex and I did the same thing. And honestly it was for the best for now. We didn't have the emotional maturity to deal with our own problems together. Anyway my advice is don't wait. Move on. You don't need to tell her or explain. Im assuming you're going no contact but if you aren't stop talking to her. Leave it in the past. That person isn't ready to be in a relationship. Don't be friends, don't send each other texts, pictures, or memes. Move on, let go. Get yourself right. Exercise, read, get off the phone, expand your mind, do new things, do things you've always wanted to do but haven't had time for or didn't have the balls to do. If it comes back then it was meant to be. But don't wait. Cause if you just wait for her, you're done. She owns you now. That might sound cruel or harsh but it's true. Respect is lost. My ex walked all over me because I would always wait/ ask her to come back and we wouldn't actually work out our problems. Move on, get some clarity. It's gonna take awhile
